name: cTSIniFile::cTSIniFile(const cIGZString& path, const cRZString* extra) (ret 8)
notes: Test AppServices3_TSIniFile: 1200 object pairs over random ini text (sandboxed, per-side copy), extra prefix null/short/empty/long, iniContext switch absent or one of ten ';' lists (leading/trailing/repeated delimiters, up to 9 tokens so the vector reallocates); fake framework slot 21, command line slots 3/8/13 and cTSAppCommonImpl slot 4 record every call and argument; compared: return, call log, base fields, prefix vector (count, capacity, each element's text/capacity/refcount/vtable), file state, untouched bytes 0x26 and 0x3c. Mutants (extra push removed, trimQuotes false, ';'->',', prefix vector not zeroed): killed. Hooked.

name: cTSIniFile::~cTSIniFile body (prefixes freed, then cRZIniFile::Destruct)
notes: Same test: after each sequence, the prefix array and every long prefix buffer are checked freed (HeapValidate right after the call), the file loses its reference, the vector fields end identical. Mutant (Tidy removed): killed. Hooked. 2026-10-24: the byte match lapsed when lane ML made the vector Tidy 0x222c0d library (our cRZStringVector::Tidy is no longer hooked there); verified by this test instead (coordinator mutant: Tidy dropped, killed by AppServices3_TSIniFile).

name: cTSIniFile::vf0 (deleting destructor, ret 4)
notes: Same test, flags 0 and 1 on heap blocks of 0x4c bytes: block freed only with bit 0, return value, prefix memory freed. Mutant (flag bit 2 instead of 1): killed; mutant with the delete size changed survives (the CRT free ignores the size: equivalent). Hooked.

name: cTSIniFile::vf6 GetString(section, key, out) (ret 0xc): tries <prefix>-<section> for each prefix, then expands %GameDataDir%
notes: Same test (about 500 GetString calls on random ini text with prefixed sections, mixed-case and doubled tokens, option query answering true/false with empty, short and heap-sized text): return, out (text, capacity, refcount), the 0x4bcfce5e query's arguments, state and file compared. Mutants (separator, token length 12, token search case-sensitive, loop ignoring the query result, first miss ends the prefix loop, query argument changed): killed. ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced (not testable: it hangs): a replacement text that itself contains the token loops forever. Hooked.

name: cTSIniFile::vf13 (section walk with prefixes, ret 0xc)
notes: Same test: a recording cdecl callback sees the same (key, value, context) sequence on both sides. The base walk cRZIniFile::vf13 (0x9c5ef2, 621 bytes) is still the game's on both sides and is called through the original cRZIniFile vtable's slot 13 (the original calls it directly). Mutant (HasSection tested on the plain section): killed. Hooked. Lane LZ: the base walk is now ours, called directly (cRZIniFile::ForEachKey) instead of through the original vtable's slot 13; tests rerun; mutant killed (the base walk's context passed as null: AppServices3_TSIniFile fails).

name: cTSIniFile::vf20 (HasSection with prefixes, ret 4)
notes: Same test (returns compared, with the base HasSection on the same section). Mutant (found returns false): killed. Hooked.

name: cRZIniFile::vf15 HasSection(section) (ret 4)
notes: Implemented as cTSIniFile::HasSection (it only uses cRZIniFile fields). Same test, also with the file disabled (the slot-5 clear after the lowercase) and missing (load fails: false without clearing). Mutants (clear removed, lowercase removed, load failure returns true): killed. Hooked.

name: cRZString token reader NextToken(char delimiter, cRZString* out) (ret 8)
notes: Test AppServices3_NextToken: 4000 strings over a small alphabet that includes the delimiter, up to 8 calls each on a reused out string (empty, short, heap-sized); results, both strings (text, size, capacity, refcount) compared. 0x1ada98 is the library's assign(str, off, count) here (the library match names append and assign alike). Mutants (token length +1, delimiter-run end +2, last-token size test, out not cleared before the swap): killed. Hooked.

name: AppendIniCommandLine: [CommandLine] Append= of the application ini appended to the command line
notes: Test AppServices3_AppendIniCommandLine: 400 runs, ini present/absent, section and key present or missing, prefixed sections ([Pre-CommandLine], [CommandLine-CommandLine]) reached through the iniContext switch, ten Append values (quotes, spaces, many arguments), the fake command line starting at ArgC 0..4; the whole call log (queries, ArgC, InsertArgument text and index) compared. Mutants (query id, key, section, index+1, ArgV(0), loop end, ini not destroyed, extra prefix passed): killed; skipping the cRZCmdLine destructor survives (a leak, not observable from the test). Hooked.
